title: Nobody Told Me: Always Cold at Work

hooks.A: The office temperature was set for a man. From the nineteen sixties.

lines.text: First week at my new job. Everyone's in T-shirts. I'm wearing three layers.
Turns out, many office temperature standards use a formula from the 1960s, based on a forty year old man.
Women's bodies usually burn energy a little slower at rest, so we make less heat.
One study found that formula can overestimate women's metabolism by up to thirty five percent.
Not everyone agrees on the details, but it's not just you. Keep a cardigan or a hot drink at your desk.
Be honest. How many layers are you wearing at work right now?
